name: Flexing for Nougat
label: Quest
description: During the festive autumn celebration of Hallow's End, Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar offers sweet seasonal confections to those willing to play along.…
intro: During the festive autumn celebration of Hallow's End, Innkeeper Gryshka in Orgrimmar offers sweet seasonal confections to those willing to play along. To earn a piece of Orgrimmar Nougat for a bedridden child, champions of the Horde must swallow their warrior pride and show off their muscles on command.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: That's an... Interesting costume you have on. Even though you're being nice and helping a sick child trick-or-treat this year, I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you perform a trick for me!
Let's see... You look so strong and buff in that... Costume... Let's see you flex! Yes, go on now and flex for me, strong friend!
When and only when you flex, I'll give you some tasty Orgrimmar Nougat. It's a great Hallow's End treat.

clips.title: Progress
paras: No candy until you flex for me, friend...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You are truly mighty, haha! Well done, and thanks for being such a good sport. Here's your candy.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
